topic: Itachi's crow was a safety net for Sasuke that paid off by freeing Itachi to speak
title: Itachi's Crow Was Never Meant To Save Itachi
description: Itachi's crow carried Shisui's Kotoamatsukami, and it was built for Sasuke, not Itachi. Here's how the crow scene, chapter 549 and chapter 550 turn it into the reason Itachi could talk to his brother. Was the plan a success or a miss?
comment: Was Itachi's crow a failed safety net for Sasuke, or the best plan he ever made? Pick one.

lines.text: Itachi's crow was never meant for Itachi.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: In the crow scene, an Itachi clone slips a crow down Naruto's throat.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: Inside it is Shisui's eye, loaded with Kotoamatsukami.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: Here's what people forgot. It targets whoever holds Itachi's Mangekyo.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: That means Sasuke. If he marched on Konoha, the crow would stop him.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: One shot, about once in ten years.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: Then chapter 549. Kabuto takes full control of Itachi.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: Nothing can reach his will. Nothing except Shisui's eye.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: Chapter 550: the crow flies out of Naruto and uses Kotoamatsukami on Itachi.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: People say the net caught the wrong person.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: But a free Itachi can stand beside Sasuke and trap Kabuto with Izanami.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: And he can talk. I think his words turned Sasuke from Konoha.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: So the crow saved Konoha by freeing the brother, not by controlling the other one.

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

lines.text: Which is why the whole time, that crow was never meant for...

shot.fallback: dark haired ninja with red eyes and a black crow, night sky

self_check.hook: contrarian claim naming Itachi in line 1
self_check.loop: last line ends mid-sentence into 'Itachi's crow was never meant for Itachi'
